projects.title: RCPIT College Query Chatbot
projects.description: An AI-based chatbot developed for R. C. Patel Institute of Technology, Shirpur to assist prospective students, parents, and visitors with instant college-related queries.
keyHighlights: Developed a chatbot interface to provide structured college information and answer student queries using an RCPIT knowledge base.
Organizing college information (departments, admission process, CAP cutoffs, fees, faculty, and facilities) into a structured dataset for accurate query retrieval.
Applying programming and AI-related concepts with Python Flask backend architecture.

architecture.frontend: Responsive web client built with HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript for smooth messaging and suggestions.
architecture.backend: Python Flask microservice handling API requests, input sanitization, and intent dispatch.
architecture.knowledgeBase: Structured information files containing verified RCPIT data on departments, fees, admissions, and campus amenities.
architecture.database: SQLite integration (currently planned / in progress) for query history, telemetry, and unresolved question logging.
